locked_conventions.zero_extension: every function on I is extended by zero to the real line before translation
locked_conventions.inversion: J*f(x)=f(-x), equivalently J*V_n=V_-n; both reflected boundary terms are retained
locked_conventions.complete_source_operator: Q_lambda=C_I^*m_lambda(D)C_I+P before parity compression or ground shifting
locked_conventions.prime_block_sign: m_lambda contains -2*sum Lambda(n)/sqrt(n)*cos(t*log(n)), preserving the minus sign in source equation (3.19)
locked_conventions.prime_power_endpoint: the right-continuous inventory includes every prime power 1<n<=lambda^2
locked_conventions.lambda_scale: a=log(lambda), L=2*log(lambda), and exp(L)=lambda^2; lambda is never substituted for lambda^2
locked_conventions.ground_state: x is the real inversion-even lowest eigenvector of the finite compressed complete source matrix; no global Weil positivity or pointwise nonnegativity of x is assumed
locked_conventions.weak_test: the compressed eigen-equation is tested against 1_I in E_N; no pointwise uncompressed eigen-equation is asserted
locked_conventions.parameter_ingestion: decimal source parameters are parsed from text and never through binary64
locked_conventions.ordinary_laplace_domain: the ordinary-Laplace derivation and numerical samples are restricted to Re(s)>1/2
locked_conventions.secret_boundary: API keys and environment secrets are neither read nor serialized

locked_formulas.weighted_sum: W(exp(t))=sum_(1<n<=exp(t)) Lambda(n)/sqrt(n), with the inclusive right-continuous endpoint convention
locked_formulas.boundary_source_identity: A1(y)=H0(a-y)+H0(a+y)+2*W(lambda^2)-W(lambda*exp(-y))-W(lambda*exp(y)) for almost every y in I
locked_formulas.boundary_cancellation_identity: A1(y)=4*lambda+2*D(L)-4*sqrt(lambda)*cosh(y/2)-F(a-y)-F(a+y) for almost every y in I
locked_formulas.signed_boundary_quotient: C_lambda(x)=X^(-1)*integral_I (F(a-y)+F(a+y))*x(y)dy=2*X^(-1)*integral_0^L F(t)*x(a-t)dt for even x and X!=0
locked_formulas.weak_compressed_identity: C_lambda(x)+epsilon-c_star=-4*h/(sqrt(lambda)*X), obtained by weakly testing the finite compressed equation against 1_I
locked_formulas.one_sided_window: h/X<=B iff c_star-epsilon-4*B/sqrt(lambda)<=C_lambda(x)<c_star-epsilon, assuming X!=0, h/X>0, and B>=0

implementation_contract.locked_pilot: lambda=2, N=2, B=2 at 80 and 160 decimal digits
implementation_contract.locked_reserve_bound: both producer and verifier require B to be the canonical exact decimal string '2'; no alternate B is accepted
implementation_contract.producer_path: split source blocks plus direct breakpoint-split integration of D, H0, and F
implementation_contract.verifier_path: unsplit source quadrature plus independently factored prime powers and a Fubini tail evaluation of the boundary convolution
implementation_contract.verifier_trust: the verifier reconstructs formulas and transcendental values from source parameters and does not trust producer matrices, booleans, or cached values
implementation_contract.inclusive_endpoint_witness: the lambda=2 inventory contains the endpoint prime power n=4=lambda^2
implementation_contract.laplace_samples: s=1 and s=1.5, both strictly inside Re(s)>1/2
implementation_contract.replay_numeric_tolerance: every serialized numeric field is replayed with abs(submitted-expected)<=10^(-(dps-6))*max(1,abs(expected)), retaining full requested precision except six guard digits
implementation_contract.signed_residual_policy: combined signed residuals are serialized before absolute values are used for pass/fail comparisons
implementation_contract.diagnostic_scope: the two precision runs are finite point diagnostics and are not extrapolated to an asymptotic theorem

arithmetic_limitations.mode: arbitrary-precision point arithmetic, not interval or ball arithmetic
arithmetic_limitations.shared_library: producer and verifier share mpmath transcendental arithmetic
arithmetic_limitations.shared_eigensolver: producer and verifier share mpmath eigsy
